gold_policy: reviewed primary qrels only; support is not scored
metric_interpretation: Binary relevance over a flat primary-gold set: Hit means at least one gold unit; Recall measures gold-unit coverage. Equivalent alternatives and jointly necessary evidence are not grouped, so these metrics do not measure answer completeness.

retrieval.query_operator: OR over unique literal alphanumeric tokens
retrieval.ranking: ascending bm25 distance; ties by unit_id
retrieval.statistics_scope: global IDF and length statistics over all snapshot units before scope filtering

publication_projection: Public path-metadata projection of the original frozen artifact. Corpus text, questions, answers, evidence, qrels, assets, scores and vectors are unchanged; no model or evaluation was rerun. Original artifact hashes are retained as origin_*.
